Lena (VP People): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Drop short questions here and we'll answer / post docs.

Jordan (IC): What's the concrete promo packet cutoff? Heard 'late April' during the town hall.

Ava (People Ops): Packet submission deadline: 2026-04-25 EOD PT. Calibration begins week of 2026-05-05.

Ravi (Eng Manager): If someone misses the cutoff for a legit reason (medical/family), is there an exception path?

Ava (People Ops): Yes. Managers submit an "exception request" via the people-ops portal with a brief note + any docs. We aim to respond within 7 business days.

Sam (Recruiter): For ICs getting external offers, can comp be adjusted mid-cycle?

Chris (CTO): We only do mid-cycle adjustments for offer-matches or clear market misalignments. Escalate to compensation + Ava; we'll triage case-by-case.

Jordan (IC): How do people raise leveling concerns if they think their mapping is wrong?

Ava (People Ops): Two options: manager raises it during packet prep for calibration, or submit a post-cycle appeal. Ideally, discuss in 1:1s early so the manager can gather evidence.

Jordan (IC): Does parental leave affect eligibility?

Ava (People Ops): Parental leave is accounted for. Managers should add context in the packet if the contribution window was reduced.

Ravi (Eng Manager): For cross-team work, what evidence is best to include?

Ava (People Ops): Measurable outcomes + short stakeholder quotes. Example bullet managers can paste: "Cross-team: Led KV cache refactor for billing service — reduced P99 by ~30ms; deploy success +8%; stakeholder note from @pay-team."

allhands-bot: New doc uploaded: packet-checklist-2026-v1.pdf (uploaded by Ava).

Lena (VP People): We're scheduling an optional 30-min packet prep office hour next Wed 9am PT. Recording will be posted.

Jordan (IC): Will promotions appear in Workday automatically?

Ava (People Ops): We ingest approved changes and update Workday; expect a 1–3 business day lag. Managers get confirmation email.

Lena (VP People): Thanks all — keeping this thread open for a few more hours for any short follow-ups. We'll post links + the office hour invite here.
